research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: CMR Surgical is researching and developing robotic surgical systems focused on enhancing minimally invasive surgery. Their work includes methods and systems for providing assistance to users of surgical robot systems, control systems for surgical robotic arms, torque sensing in surgical robotic wrists, arrangements of electrosurgical instruments, and real-time image correction of endoscope video streams. These areas collectively address precision, control, safety, and integration in robotic-assisted surgery.

overview_description.description:
CMR Surgical develops and manufactures robotic surgical systems designed to enhance precision and efficiency in minimally invasive surgery. Its primary product, Versius, is a versatile and modular robotic system that supports various surgical procedures.

Versius is designed to mimic the human arm's flexibility while offering a compact and ergonomic design. It integrates with hospital workflows and provides data-driven insights to support surgical performance. CMR Surgical collaborates with healthcare professionals to ensure that its technology meets clinical needs and improves patient outcomes.

about_short_description.short_description: CMR Surgical develops and manufactures robotic surgical systems to enhance precision and efficiency in minimally invasive surgery.

product.name: Versius Plus
product.description: A modular robotic-assisted surgical system for controlling endoscopic instruments during minimally invasive soft-tissue procedures. In the U.S., it is FDA 510(k)-cleared for adult cholecystectomy procedures.

product.name: Versius Surgical System
product.description: A robotic surgical platform that assists surgeons in controlling endoscopic instruments during minimally invasive surgery across applicable clinical procedures and geographies.

product.name: Versius Digital Ecosystem
product.description: A software and data environment supporting the Versius platform with procedural logging, hospital usage dashboards, software updates, and clinical and operational monitoring.

product.name: vLimeLite Visualization System
product.description: An integrated fluorescence visualization system for Versius that provides real-time imaging with indocyanine green, multiple viewing modes, automatic brightness control, and 3DHD display support.

product.name: Versius Surgical Instruments
product.description: A suite of articulated electrosurgical and non-electrosurgical endoscopic instruments used with Versius robotic systems for tissue manipulation, dissection, cutting, and coagulation.
